runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 16:36 sweep across 13 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Brigada.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs tech-creative discovery, Upwork/Freelancer/Twine freelance discovery, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. IKEA job 354106 was freshly reverified as active. Profesia surfaced Tatra Supercompute L1 AI data-centre Service Desk in Bratislava at 1,800 EUR, but explicit B2 active English, English CV and 24/7 three-shift operation are major profile penalties, so it was not promoted. Kariera surfaced CCI Slovakia customer centre at 1,330 EUR, but canonical detail requires C1/C2 English, Ukrainian, Russian and Slovak plus six years of experience, so it was rejected. StartupJobs surfaced Tipli full-remote Product Manager and Medevio 100% remote BDR, but both are outside preferred scope/seniority. Upwork surfaced WooCommerce data-entry and e-commerce VA jobs; fixed budgets/saturation or English/application friction keep them below promotion threshold. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Multi-constraint disqualifier extractor
developmentChanges.reason: When a listing combines several hard or near-hard mismatches such as B2/C1 language, English-only application artifacts, 24/7 shifts or excessive required experience, persist the combined reason once so repeated runs do not waste time re-evaluating the same attractive headline/pay.

developmentChanges.title: Category-page to detail verification queue
developmentChanges.reason: When a source category/index page surfaces a promising title and salary, automatically queue the exact detail for requirement verification before promotion. This prevents false positives like CCI customer support, whose attractive category listing hides C1/C2 multilingual and six-year-experience requirements.
